contacts.title: VP of Data Science

contacts.title: Head of Analytics

contacts.title: Chief Data Officer
contacts.rationale: Responsible for overall data strategy and likely involved in senior-level hiring.

contacts.title: Director of Data Science
contacts.rationale: Could be a peer or report to the Head of Data Science, providing insights into the team structure.

contacts.title: HR Manager
contacts.rationale: Involved in the recruitment process and can provide details about the role.

contacts.title: Chief Technology Officer
